ns2:course.label: Leading School Improvement
ns2:course.description: Study of major ideas on school improvement, past and present, and of emerging research on the condition of public education in the United States. In-depth examination of reform proposals for changing the organization of schools, the instructional program, and the roles of students, teachers, and school administrators. Same as EPOL 536. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EPOL 536. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
